title: Speed camera
hints: Start a counter at 0, look at every speed, and add 1 to the counter each time a car breaks the rule.
Inside a `for (size_t i = 0; i < count; i++)` loop, check `if (speeds[i] > limit)`. Use `>`, not `>=`: driving exactly at the limit is allowed.
`size_t speeding = 0; for (size_t i = 0; i < count; i++) { if (speeds[i] > limit) speeding++; } return speeding;`
